subject: The preset I made at 3AM
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this. But then I heard what it does to a kick drum.
body_paragraphs: Three days ago I couldn't sleep. I was listening to Travis Scott through my earbuds and something was missing. The drop should've hit my chest, but it just... didn't. So I opened the app and started tweaking the EQ. Two hours later, I had something I didn't expect.

This isn't one of those generic presets you see everywhere. I dialed in a specific curve that makes sub-bass frequencies hit like a 12-inch subwoofer. Hip-hop kicks punch. EDM drops actually drop. Rock riffs have weight. I tested it on 12 different songs, from Kendrick to Skrillex to Led Zeppelin. Every single one felt different.

I wasn't going to put this in the app. But then I thought about you, sitting there with flat audio, not knowing what your phone can actually do. So I added it as a hidden profile called '3AM Bass.' It's live right now. Open Bass Booster, tap the EQ profiles, and select it. You'll feel the difference in the first 5 seconds.
Open the app right now and find '3AM Bass' under the profiles tab. PS — I'm keeping this one hidden for the next 48 hours. After that, I might pull it. Don't say I never gave you anything.
